seoDescription: Find GCPS 2026–27 key dates, including the first and last days of school, major breaks, digital learning days, early-release dates, and the official PDF.

heroSummary: Gwinnett County Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 5, 2026. The last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Major breaks include Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, and Spring Break. The calendar also includes digital learning and early-release days, which may require different childcare or transportation arrangements.
calendarNotes: The official GCPS 2026–27 calendar lists 180 student days. Digital learning days are September 18, November 3, and March 19. Elementary and middle school early-release days are October 28–29 and March 3–4; high school exam early-release windows are December 16–18 and May 24–26. January 4 is a teacher planning and staff development day, and students begin the second semester on January 5.
heroFactChips: Students return after Winter Break on Jan 5, 2027

calendarFaqs.q: When does GCPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Gwinnett County Public Schools starts the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 5, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCPS Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a teacher planning and staff development day, and students begin the second semester on Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Are GCPS digital learning days regular school days?
calendarFaqs.a: Digital learning days are instructional days completed remotely; students do not attend school in person. The 2026–27 GCPS calendar lists digital learning days on September 18, November 3, and March 19.

calendarFaqs.q: Are GCPS early-release dates the same for every grade level?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Elementary and middle school early-release days are October 28–29 and March 3–4. High school exam early-release windows are December 16–18 and May 24–26.

calendarFaqs.q: Does GCPS publish translated calendars for 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. GCPS publishes 2026–27 calendar PDFs in Chinese, Korean, Spanish, and Vietnamese in addition to the English version.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families check for GCPS calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official GCPS calendar page and your school's announcements for the latest schedule changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the GCPS school calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Download the MySchoolDates 2026–27 ICS file and import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. This is a one-time import and will not update automatically if GCPS revises its calendar.
